patterns.note: Extensive use of grid-based card layouts for displaying diverse content such as promotions, hotels, and recommendations, maintaining a consistent visual rhythm across various sections.
The primary booking/search form is integrated directly below the hero banner, using a tabbed interface to switch between different travel services (flights, hotels, etc.).

A deep, rich brand blue (#00146E) is consistently used for key informational section backgrounds, call-to-action buttons, and prominent text, providing strong contrast against white and light grey backgrounds.

The main navigation bar, including the brand logo and utility links, transitions to a fixed, sticky position at the top of the viewport after the initial hero section scrolls out of view, ensuring persistent access.
Accordion components are utilized on interior pages to organize detailed information, allowing users to expand and collapse content sections for improved readability and reduced visual clutter.

technique_notes: The main navigation bar is implemented to stick to the top of the browser window once the user scrolls past the initial hero content, maintaining its full size and layout.
Content sections below the hero are revealed through standard vertical scrolling, with no complex scroll-triggered fade-ins or slide-up animations for individual elements.

Interactive horizontal carousels, powered by Swiper, are used for the main hero banner and for several content blocks (e.g., 'ANAからご案内'), enabling users to browse multiple items efficiently within a confined horizontal space.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clear and prominent, typically sans-serif, with a balanced size relationship to the legible sans-serif body text, maintaining a professional and informative character.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — applied to buttons, input fields, and card corners for a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — with an airy hero section transitioning to a more compact, yet well-spaced, grid layout for feature cards and content blocks.

standout: This site stands out for its meticulous organization of a vast amount of information, presenting a highly functional and dense content architecture within a clean, almost minimal Japanese aesthetic. The consistent use of horizontal carousels for diverse content types, from hero banners to informational cards, is a distinctive approach to managing content density and user engagement.
